live.name: Bollywood and Punjabi live bands
live.h1: Bollywood and Punjabi live bands to book in India
live.intro: A live band turns a function into an event. Our roster covers Bollywood, Punjabi, retro and pop sets, from tight five-piece bands for a sangeet to larger groups for a reception or concert-style night.
live.tips: Start with the room and the crowd. Ask how long the band plays, how many sets it can break into, and whether it brings its own sound and backline. A band that can mix Bollywood and Punjabi hits with a few English numbers suits a mixed family crowd best.
faq: How do I choose between a live band and a DJ?

A live band brings energy and a stage moment, while a DJ keeps the floor going for hours. Many weddings book a band for the first part of the night and a DJ after it. Our guide on choosing between a DJ and a live band explains the trade-offs.
Can a band play a custom set for my event?
Often yes. Share the mood, languages and any must-play songs when you enquire and we will confirm what each band can do before you book.

celeb.name: Celebrity artists
celeb.h1: Celebrity artists and singers for private and corporate events
celeb.intro: Big names, playback singers, Punjabi stars and special guests for weddings, brand events and shows. We bring the artist, the team and the coordination together so you deal with one person.
celeb.tips: Decide first whether you want a full performance or a short appearance, because they are booked and priced differently. Celebrity artists have fixed touring calendars, so confirm your date early and share the venue, audience size and run of show.
faq: How early should I book a celebrity artist?
As early as your date is fixed. Popular artists tour heavily, and wedding and festive seasons fill up first.
What is the difference between an appearance and a live show?

An appearance is a short presence at your event, while a live show is a full performance with sound, a band and a set list. Our guide on choosing a celebrity guest or a live show covers this in detail.

solosing.name: Solo singers
solosing.h1: Solo singers to book for weddings and events
solosing.intro: A solo singer with a track or a small accompaniment suits intimate functions, cocktail hours, musical pheras and dinners. Our roster includes Bollywood, retro, indie and sufi voices.
solosing.tips: Check the repertoire and language mix, and ask whether the singer performs live with a track, a guitarist or a keyboardist. For musical pheras or a quiet ceremony, ask for a short sample of the softer songs.
faq: Is a solo singer enough for a large wedding?
It works well for the ceremony, cocktail and dinner. For a high-energy sangeet or reception many families add a band or a DJ.
Do solo singers bring their own sound?
Arrangements vary by artist. Tell us the venue and guest count and we will confirm what is included.

dj.name: DJs
dj.h1: DJs to book for weddings, parties and corporate events
dj.intro: From wedding DJs who read a mixed crowd to club-style DJs for New Year parties and college fests, our DJs play Bollywood, Punjabi, house and open-format sets.
dj.tips: Ask what a DJ brings: sound, lights, a console and a back-up. For weddings, mention the family mix and key moments such as entries and baraat so the playlist is planned around them. Share your genre preferences and any songs to avoid.
faq: Do DJs bring their own equipment?
Many do, but the setup differs from act to act. Tell us the venue and we will confirm what is included in your quote.
Can I combine a DJ with a live act?
Yes. A DJ with a percussionist, a singer or a band is a popular combination, and several acts on our roster are built that way.

sufibolly.name: Sufi Bollywood bands
sufibolly.h1: Sufi and Bollywood bands to book in India
sufibolly.intro: Sufi Bollywood bands blend soulful sufi numbers with film favourites. They work for sangeets, receptions, corporate evenings and festivals where you want depth as well as familiar songs.
sufibolly.tips: Ask for the song list and how long the set runs. These bands suit seated or semi-seated audiences well, so mention the layout of the venue when you enquire.
faq: What is the difference between sufi Bollywood and qawwali?
Sufi Bollywood bands perform contemporary sufi and film songs, while qawwali groups perform the traditional call and response form with harmonium and chorus.
Are these bands suitable for weddings?
Yes, they are popular for sangeets, receptions and cocktail evenings.

djband.name: DJ based bands
djband.h1: DJ based bands and live electronic acts
djband.intro: These acts combine a DJ set with live vocals, instruments or percussion, so the floor stays full while the stage still feels live.
djband.tips: Ask which parts of the set are live and which are mixed. They are a strong fit for sangeets, receptions and parties where you want one act to cover the whole evening.
faq: Why book a DJ based band instead of a DJ alone?
A live element on stage brings a visual moment and variety to the night, while the DJ side keeps the music continuous.
How long can they play?
Sets vary by act. Share your schedule and we will confirm timings and breaks.

anchor.name: Anchors and emcees
anchor.h1: Anchors and emcees for weddings, awards and corporate shows
anchor.intro: An anchor keeps your programme on time and your guests engaged. Our anchors host weddings, sangeets, award nights, launches and college events in Hindi, English and mixed styles.
anchor.tips: Share the run of show, languages and the tone you want, such as warm and family friendly or sharp and corporate. Ask whether the anchor handles games, announcements and artist introductions.
faq: Do I need an anchor at my event?
For a large event or a programme with several moments, an anchor keeps things moving. For a small gathering you may not need one.
Can the anchor work alongside the band or DJ?
Yes. A good anchor coordinates with the artists and the production team throughout the evening.

soloinst.name: Solo instrumentalists
soloinst.h1: Solo instrumentalists: violin, flute, sitar, keyboard and more
soloinst.intro: A solo instrumentalist adds a refined mood to a ceremony, cocktail hour or lounge. Our roster includes violin, flute, sitar, piano and other instruments.
soloinst.tips: Match the instrument to the moment. Strings and flute suit arrivals and ceremonies, while a keyboard or piano works well for lounges and dinners. Ask for the repertoire and whether a backing track is used.
faq: Can an instrumentalist play Bollywood songs?
Many of them do, along with classical, fusion and pop pieces. Share the songs you have in mind when you enquire.
Is a solo instrumentalist loud enough for a big venue?
Sound is arranged to suit the venue. Tell us the space and guest count so the setup is planned properly.

duotrio.name: Duos and trios
duotrio.h1: Duos and trios to book for lounges, dinners and weddings
duotrio.intro: Small acts with big presence. Duos and trios fit cocktail hours, restaurants, intimate functions and weddings where a full band would not fit.
duotrio.tips: Check the line-up and whether the act can scale up for a larger moment. Ask about set length and how the act handles breaks.
faq: What is a duo or trio suited to?
They work well for cocktail hours, dinners, lounge evenings, engagements and mehendis.
Can a trio play a full evening?
Many can, with breaks. Share your timings and we will confirm.

magiccomedy.name: Magicians and comedians
magiccomedy.h1: Magicians, mentalists and comedians for events
magiccomedy.intro: Magic, mentalism and comedy break the ice and give guests something to talk about. They suit weddings, kids parties, corporate evenings and award nights.
magiccomedy.tips: Match the act to the audience. Close-up magic suits cocktail hours, stage illusions suit larger rooms, and comedy depends on the crowd and the language. Ask about the set length and any venue needs.
faq: Can magicians perform for children and adults together?
Many acts are built for mixed family audiences. Mention the age mix so the right act is suggested.
Do comedians change their material for corporate events?
Corporate shows usually need clean, audience-aware material. Share the tone you want when you enquire.

bollyrock.name: Bollywood rock bands
bollyrock.intro: Film songs with a rock edge for crowds that want energy. These bands and singers suit college fests, corporate nights, New Year parties and high-energy receptions.
bollyrock.tips: Ask for the set list and the proportion of Bollywood to English rock. For a mixed family crowd, check how the band handles slower numbers.
faq: Is Bollywood rock suitable for weddings?
It works well for receptions and sangeets where you want a younger, high-energy feel.
How loud is a rock band at a banquet?
Volume can be managed. Tell us the venue and any sound limits.

sufiq.name: Sufi qawwali groups
sufiq.h1: Sufi and qawwali groups to book in India
sufiq.intro: Traditional qawwali groups and sufi ensembles for mehfils, weddings, corporate evenings and festivals. Expect harmonium, chorus and a build that lifts the room.
sufiq.tips: Qawwali works best with an attentive, seated audience. Ask about the group size, set length and whether a stage or floor seating is needed.
faq: What events suit a qawwali night?
Sufi nights, sangeets, mehfils, anniversaries, corporate dinners and festivals.
How many people perform?
Group sizes vary from small ensembles to a full chorus. Share the venue size and we will recommend the right setup.

western.name: Western bands
western.h1: Western bands for parties, weddings and corporate events
western.intro: English pop, rock and indie sets for people who want a different sound. Our western acts suit lounges, corporate evenings, college fests and cocktail nights.
western.tips: Ask for the genre mix, such as classic rock, pop hits or indie, and whether the band can add a few Bollywood numbers for a mixed crowd.
faq: Can a western band play Hindi songs?
Some do. Tell us the mix you want and we will confirm with the band.
Are western bands suitable for weddings?
They suit cocktail nights and receptions, especially with younger or international guests.

djperc.name: DJ and percussion acts
djperc.intro: A DJ paired with a live percussionist or dhol player adds rhythm and a visual moment to the dance floor.
djperc.tips: Ask which instruments are on stage and how the live percussion is used through the set. These acts fit sangeets, receptions, baraats and parties.
faq: Why add percussion to a DJ set?
Live percussion lifts the energy and gives guests something to watch as well as dance to.
Can they play for a baraat?
Several acts suit a baraat or entry. Mention it when you enquire.

instrband.name: Instrumental bands
instrband.h1: Instrumental bands for weddings and lounges
instrband.intro: Instrumental bands play familiar songs on violin, piano, guitar or strings, with no vocals. They are a graceful fit for ceremonies, dinners and receptions.
instrband.tips: Ask for the song list and the line-up. For a ceremony, share the moments you want music for, such as the entry and the pheras.
faq: What is an instrumental band best for?
Ceremonies, cocktail hours, dinners and quiet receptions where conversation matters.
Can they play Bollywood songs?
Yes, many arrange popular Bollywood and English songs.

devotional.name: Devotional and bhajan singers
devotional.intro: Bhajan singers and devotional groups for jagrans, chowkis, housewarmings, pujas and festive evenings.
devotional.tips: Share the deity, the language and the length of the programme. Ask about the group size and what is needed on stage.
faq: Can they perform at home events?
Yes, many acts suit home functions. Tell us the space and we will confirm.
Which languages do they sing in?
Hindi, Punjabi and Gujarati are common. Share your preference when you enquire.

allgirl.name: All-girl bands
allgirl.h1: All-girl bands to book in India
allgirl.intro: All-women bands bring polished live music to weddings, corporate events, college fests and brand evenings.
allgirl.tips: Ask for the genre mix and the set length. Share the room size and crowd so the right line-up is suggested.
faq: What do all-girl bands play?
Bollywood, pop, retro and rock, depending on the band. Share your preferences and we will match.
Are they available across India?
Several travel. Tell us your city and date and we will confirm.

ghazal.name: Ghazal and classical singers
ghazal.intro: Ghazal and classical performers for refined evenings, anniversaries, private dinners and cultural events.
ghazal.tips: These acts suit an attentive, seated audience. Share the guest profile and the length you want.
faq: Can they sing film ghazals and retro songs?
Many mix classical and ghazal pieces with retro film songs. Share your wish list.
What setup do they need?
Usually a small stage, sound and seating. We confirm details before you book.

standup.name: Stand-up comedians
standup.h1: Stand-up comedians for corporate and private events
standup.intro: Stand-up comedians for corporate evenings, launches, college events and private shows.
standup.tips: Tell us the audience, language and tone. Corporate and family audiences need different material, so share any topics to avoid.
faq: Can a comedian do a clean corporate set?
Yes, share your guidelines and the set is planned around them.
How long are the sets?
Set length depends on the act and the event. Share your schedule and we will confirm.

rap.name: Rappers and hip hop acts
rap.h1: Rappers and hip hop acts to book
rap.intro: Hip hop and rap acts for college fests, brand events, club nights and large shows.
rap.tips: Ask for the set length and whether the artist performs with a DJ or a band. Share the age profile and any content guidelines.
faq: Can rappers perform at corporate events?
Yes, with guidelines. Share your audience and we will advise.
Do they bring a DJ?
Many do. Confirm the setup with us when you enquire.

choir.name: Choirs and carol groups
choir.intro: Choirs and carol groups for Christmas events, weddings, corporate celebrations and festive evenings.
choir.tips: Ask for the song list, the group size and the stage space needed. Share the dates early in the festive season.
faq: Do choirs perform outside Christmas?
Yes. Many perform at weddings, corporate events and special occasions through the year.
How many singers perform?
It varies by group. Share your venue and we will recommend a size.

rajfusion.name: Rajasthani folk and fusion acts
rajfusion.intro: Rajasthani folk singers, dholi and fusion groups that bring colour and rhythm to weddings, welcome moments and cultural evenings.
rajfusion.tips: Ask about the line-up and any dancers or instruments. These acts suit entries, mehendis and outdoor evenings.
faq: Can they play for a wedding entry?
Many folk acts suit entries and welcome moments. Mention it in your enquiry.
Are they a fit for corporate events?
Yes, for cultural evenings, festivals and themed nights.

lounge.name: Lounge acts
lounge.h1: Lounge acts for cocktails, dinners and brunches
lounge.intro: Soft, stylish live music for cocktail hours, dinners, brunches and hotel evenings.
lounge.tips: Share the venue, the time of day and the mood. Ask about the line-up and the volume you need.
faq: What do lounge acts play?
Soft Bollywood, retro, jazz and pop arrangements, depending on the act.
Are they suitable for restaurants and cafes?
Yes, for hotel, restaurant and cafe nights.

jazz.name: Jazz bands
jazz.h1: Jazz bands to book in India
jazz.intro: Jazz bands for lounges, cocktail nights, corporate evenings and festivals, with a polished, relaxed feel.
jazz.tips: Ask for the line-up and the mix of jazz standards and familiar songs. Share the venue and the audience profile.
faq: Can a jazz band play popular songs?
Many play jazz arrangements of familiar songs. Share your preferences.
Which events suit jazz?
Cocktail nights, lounges, corporate dinners and festivals.

wedding.name: Weddings
wedding.h1: Live music and artists for weddings in India
wedding.intro: A wedding has many moments, and each one needs a different kind of act. We help you build the line-up, from the baraat and ceremony to the sangeet and reception.
wedding.tips: Map the day first, then match acts to moments: a singer or instrumentalist for the ceremony, a band for the sangeet, a DJ for the late night. Share the dates, venues and guest count, and we will suggest a mix and send videos with a quote.
faq: How early should I book wedding artists?
As soon as your dates are fixed. Popular acts fill their winter calendars early.
Can you plan music for the whole wedding?
Yes. We shortlist, finalise and coordinate acts across the events, with one person to call.

sangeet.name: Sangeet and cocktail nights
sangeet.h1: Artists for sangeet and cocktail nights
sangeet.intro: The sangeet is the loudest, most personal night of the wedding. The right act keeps families on the floor and the programme moving.
sangeet.tips: Pair a high-energy band or DJ with an anchor to run performances and games. Share the family mix so the set list works for all ages.
faq: Which is better for a sangeet, a DJ or a live band?
Many families book both: a band for the first part and a DJ for the dance floor. See our guide for how to decide.
Do you provide an anchor for the sangeet?
Yes, we have anchors who host sangeets and coordinate family performances.

reception.name: Receptions
reception.intro: A reception needs music that feels polished and keeps a mixed crowd comfortable, from arrival to the last dance.
reception.tips: Plan a quieter first hour with a singer, instrumentalist or duo, and move to a band or DJ for the dance floor. Share the timeline and stage space.
faq: How long should the music run at a reception?
It depends on your timeline and the act. Share the schedule and we will plan the sets.
Can I add a celebrity performance?
Yes. Share the date and venue and we will check availability.

haldi.name: Haldi
haldi.h1: Music and artists for haldi ceremonies
haldi.intro: Haldi is bright, informal and daytime. Dhol, a DJ or a folk singer set the mood.
haldi.tips: Keep the setup light and mobile, since many haldis are outdoors. Ask about sound that works in open spaces and mid-day timings.
faq: Is a DJ right for a haldi?
Yes, a DJ with a dhol or percussionist is a popular choice.
Can artists perform outdoors in the daytime?
Yes. Tell us the venue and we will confirm the setup.

mehendi.name: Mehendi
mehendi.intro: Mehendi is relaxed and sociable. Live singers, duos and folk acts keep the mood light while guests mingle.
mehendi.tips: Choose an act that works at a conversational volume early on, with the option to lift the energy later. Ask about unplugged or small setups.
faq: What music suits a mehendi?
Soft Bollywood, sufi and folk sets, with a DJ later in the evening.
Can the act perform at a home or a lawn?
Yes. Share the space and the guest count.

engagement.name: Engagement and roka
engagement.h1: Artists for engagements and roka ceremonies
engagement.intro: Engagements and rokas call for music that feels warm and celebratory without drowning out the ceremony.
engagement.tips: A singer or instrumentalist for the ceremony, and a DJ or band for the celebration afterwards, works well.
faq: Can the same artist play through the ceremony and party?
Some acts can. Share the schedule and we will plan it.
How big should the act be?
Match it to the guest count and the venue.

baraat.name: Baraat
baraat.intro: A baraat needs rhythm and spectacle: dhol, a DJ and a crowd that wants to dance in the street.
baraat.tips: Plan the route, the timing and the power for sound. Ask whether dhol players, a mobile DJ and an anchor can work together.
faq: Can a DJ play on a moving baraat?
Yes, with a suitable setup. Tell us the route and we will confirm.
Do you arrange dhol players?
Several acts on our roster include live percussion.

pheras.name: Musical pheras
pheras.h1: Singers and instrumentalists for musical pheras
pheras.intro: Musical pheras add a personal soundtrack to the ceremony, from soft instrumental pieces to singers who match the rituals.
pheras.tips: Share the order of rituals and the songs you want. Ask for samples of slower, soulful songs and check the microphone setup.
faq: What do musical pheras sound like?
Soft Bollywood, classical and sufi songs timed to each ritual.
Can we choose the songs?
Yes. Share your list and we will confirm with the artist.

birthday.name: Birthday parties
birthday.h1: Singers, bands and DJs for birthday parties
birthday.intro: From a milestone birthday dinner to a big party, the right act sets the mood for the guest list.
birthday.tips: Pick the format by the crowd: a singer or trio for a dinner, a DJ or band for a dance party. Share the age mix and the favourite songs.
faq: Singer, band or DJ for a birthday?
It depends on the crowd and the mood. Our guide to birthday party music explains how to choose.
Do you cover home parties?
Yes, we match acts to home, banquet and restaurant venues.

kidsbday.name: Kids birthday parties
kidsbday.h1: Entertainers and DJs for kids birthday parties
kidsbday.intro: Magicians, DJs and anchors who keep children and parents engaged with games, tricks and music.
kidsbday.tips: Ask for age-appropriate content and a set length that matches children's attention spans. Share the venue and the number of kids.
faq: What entertains kids best?
Magic, games with an anchor, and a DJ playing kid-friendly songs.
How long should the entertainment run?
It depends on the age group and the act. Share the schedule and we will suggest a length.

babyshower.name: Baby showers and godh bharai
babyshower.h1: Artists for baby showers and godh bharai
babyshower.intro: Baby showers and godh bharai are warm family occasions, best served by gentle, friendly entertainment.
babyshower.tips: A singer, duo or instrumentalist suits the ceremony, and an anchor or magician can keep games light for guests.
faq: What music suits a baby shower?
Soft, familiar songs at a conversational volume.
Can an anchor run the games?
Yes, many anchors host games and rituals.

housewarming.name: Housewarming
housewarming.intro: Housewarmings are happiest with music that fits a home: devotional singers for the puja and a singer or trio for the party.
housewarming.tips: Share the space and the setup possible at home. Ask for compact acts that need little room.
faq: Can artists perform in an apartment?
Yes, small acts work well. Tell us the space.
Do you offer devotional singers?
Yes, for pujas and chowkis.

retirement.name: Retirement and farewell parties
retirement.h1: Artists for retirement and farewell parties
retirement.intro: A farewell or retirement party deserves music with memory: retro songs, a warm singer and a host who keeps things personal.
retirement.tips: Share the guest profile, the era of songs the guest of honour loves and the order of speeches.
faq: What music suits a retirement party?
Retro Bollywood and favourites of the guest of honour.
Do we need an anchor?
Useful for speeches and tributes.

bachelor.name: Bachelor and bachelorette parties
bachelor.h1: DJs and artists for bachelor and bachelorette parties
bachelor.intro: High-energy DJs, rappers and bands for the last night out, at a club, a villa or a pool.
bachelor.tips: Share the venue, the crowd and the energy you want. Ask about sound, lights and timing for private venues.
faq: Can a DJ play at a villa or a pool?
Yes, with the right setup. Tell us the venue.
Can we add a live act?
Yes, a DJ and percussionist or a band can add live energy.

diwali.name: Diwali parties
diwali.h1: Artists for Diwali parties and corporate celebrations
diwali.intro: Diwali parties run from family evenings to corporate celebrations. Bands, singers and DJs set the festive mood.
diwali.tips: Book early, because festive dates fill fast. Share the format of the evening and the guest mix.
faq: How early should I book for Diwali?
As soon as your date is fixed. Festive dates are in high demand.
Do you cover corporate Diwali parties?
Yes, with acts suited to office crowds.

garba.name: Garba and dandiya nights
garba.h1: Artists for garba and dandiya nights
garba.intro: Garba and dandiya nights need rhythm, folk songs and a crowd that keeps moving. Live singers and DJs bring the beat.
garba.tips: Ask for a set that suits circle dances and traditional steps. Confirm the sound, stage and floor space.
faq: Do you have singers for garba?
Yes, including Gujarati folk singers.
Can a DJ play garba music?
Yes, with a set tuned for dandiya and garba.

holi.name: Holi parties
holi.h1: DJs and artists for Holi parties
holi.intro: Holi parties need loud, colourful, danceable music, often outdoors.
holi.tips: Plan for water and colour around equipment. Confirm a safe setup and the sound for open spaces.
faq: Can artists perform at a Holi party outdoors?
Yes, with a suitable setup. Share the venue.
Which acts suit Holi?
DJs, DJ and percussion acts, and energetic bands.

chowki.name: Mata ki chowki
chowki.h1: Singers for mata ki chowki and jagrans
chowki.intro: Devotional singers and groups for chowkis and jagrans, with bhajans that gather the whole family.
chowki.tips: Share the date, the deity and the length of the programme. Ask about the group size and the sound needed.
faq: Do you have bhajan singers for home chowkis?
Yes, share the space and the guest count.
Can an anchor help?
Yes, for larger programmes.

christmas.name: Christmas parties
christmas.h1: Artists for Christmas parties and carol evenings
christmas.intro: Carol groups, choirs, bands and DJs for Christmas events at hotels, offices and homes.
christmas.tips: Book early in the festive season. Share the setting and the mix of carols and party songs.
faq: Do you have carol groups?
Yes, choirs and carol groups are on our roster.
Can a band play both carols and party songs?
Many can. Share your plan.

newyear.name: New Year parties
newyear.h1: Bands and DJs for New Year parties
newyear.intro: New Year is the biggest night for live music. Bands, DJs and special acts take guests from the countdown into the new year.
newyear.tips: Book as early as possible, since the best acts fill their calendars months ahead. Share the venue, capacity and the sets you want before and after midnight.
faq: How early should I book for New Year?
As soon as the venue is confirmed. Popular acts are booked months ahead.
Can an act play across midnight?
Yes. Share the schedule and we will plan the sets.

college.name: College fests
college.h1: Bands, DJs and artists for college fests
college.intro: College fests need big crowds, strong sets and artists who know how to work an audience.
college.tips: Share the budget range, the venue and the headline slot. Ask about sound, backline and set length.
faq: Can you handle a headline act?
Yes, including celebrity artists. Share the dates and budget.
Do you offer support acts?
Yes, DJs and bands can fill pre-headline slots.

corporate.name: Corporate events
corporate.h1: Artists for corporate events, galas and offsites
corporate.intro: From annual dinners to team celebrations, corporate events need acts that are reliable, on time and right for the audience.
corporate.tips: Share the audience profile, the programme and any content guidelines. We handle the contract and the coordination.
faq: Can you handle a corporate contract and invoicing?
Yes. We handle the booking details and the coordination.
Do you have anchors and comedians?
Yes, for hosting and entertainment.

launch.name: Product launches and brand events
launch.h1: Artists for product launches and brand events
launch.intro: Launches and brand activations need acts that draw a crowd and fit the brand: celebrity guests, DJs, anchors and performers.
launch.tips: Share the brand tone, the run of show and the audience. Ask about appearances, stage moments and content approvals.
faq: Can you arrange a celebrity guest?
Yes, share the date and the brief.
Do you offer anchors?
Yes, for launches and award nights.

annualday.name: Annual days and award nights
annualday.h1: Artists for annual days and award nights
annualday.intro: Annual days and award nights run on a tight programme with performances, hosting and moments of fun.
annualday.tips: Share the run of show and the stage. An anchor and one or two performances keep it on schedule.
faq: Do you offer an anchor?
Yes, anchors host annual days and award nights.
Can we book a headline performance?
Yes, share the budget and the date.

venue.name: Restaurant, cafe and hotel nights
venue.h1: Live acts for restaurants, cafes and hotels
venue.intro: Live music brings guests in and keeps them there. Singers, duos and bands suit restaurants, cafes, bars and hotels.
venue.tips: Share the space, the days and the typical crowd. Ask about compact setups and set lengths.
faq: Can you set up a weekly live night?
Yes, share the days and we will suggest acts.
How compact can the setup be?
Solo and duo acts need very little space.

brunch.name: Brunch and lounge
brunch.intro: Brunch and lounge settings call for relaxed live music: soft vocals, strings and chilled sets.
brunch.tips: Match the volume to the venue and the time of day. Ask for light, familiar songs.
faq: What music suits a brunch?
Soft Bollywood, retro and pop at a conversational volume.
Can the act play a few sets?
Yes, share the timings.

house.name: House parties
house.h1: DJs and artists for house parties
house.intro: House parties work best with a compact setup that fits the space: a DJ, a singer or a small band.
house.tips: Share the room size, the guest count and the neighbours' sound limits. Ask for compact kits.
faq: Can an act perform at home?
Yes, small acts suit homes and apartments.
Do I need to arrange sound?
Tell us what you have and we will confirm what to bring.

pool.name: Pool and beach parties
pool.h1: DJs and artists for pool and beach parties
pool.intro: Pool and beach parties run on summer beats: DJs, percussion and bands that handle open air.
pool.tips: Confirm power, shade and equipment safety near water. Share the timing and the crowd.
faq: Can a DJ play by the pool?
Yes, with a suitable, safe setup.
Do you arrange sound for outdoors?
Tell us the venue and we will confirm.

Delhi.name: Delhi
